title: Development of novel composite data quality scores to evaluate facility-level data quality in electronic data in Kenya: a nationwide retrospective cohort study
why_not: Its KHIS data run from January 2011 to June 2018 and cover 187 sampled HIV facilities with EMRs; it says summary forms are uploaded to KHIS without saying who keys them or at which tier, and its 61.1% completeness score measures missing HIV indicator pairs, not a reporting rate.
